proposition: Apparent support volume must be reduced to independent causal ancestry or the appropriate clustered independent unit before it can increase confidence in a premise.
evidence_summary: The pre-mining source audit identified causal-ancestry pseudoreplication as distinct from ordinary population relevance; Phase-1/2 mining independently found that repeated lens/report appearances often share source ancestry and cannot be counted as empirical replication.
solve_count_link: Overcounting correlated observations can falsely promote or close solver premises without any new independent evidence.
mechanic_resources: causal ancestry; clustered unit; independent support

proposition: Evidence status is path-dependent and consumable: once an evaluation block or population outcome influences descendant design, it becomes development evidence for those descendants even if it was originally untouched confirmation evidence.
evidence_summary: Evaluation and operating-model authorities explicitly treat confirmation evidence as spent for descendants after its outcomes influence redesign; v1 temporal/architecture conditioning does not encode that observer-use transition.
solve_count_link: Reusing consumed confirmation evidence as if it were independent can manufacture generalization confidence and hide adaptive overfitting.
mechanic_resources: development evidence; confirmation evidence; evidence ancestry

proposition: As a research result propagates through reports, capability memory, question state, future-work prose, or execution priority, downstream claims must preserve its scope, conditioning, information authority, causal ancestry, and maturity rather than silently broadening them.
evidence_summary: P197/P198 define authority and maturity at the source, while inference-audit work identifies downstream semantic drift as a separate failure process. Phase-2 S2-C01 independently rediscovered that measurement authority must travel with evidence.
solve_count_link: A narrow or observer-only result can otherwise become an overbroad closure

proposition: An observation supports a causal research conclusion only to the extent that the observation could discriminate that conclusion from materially different rival explanations.
evidence_summary: The repository repeatedly distinguishes capability absent from unoffered/starved, premise false from implementation-form failure, and structural phenomena from selection/observer artifacts. Phase-2 synthesis preserved rival interpretations and hostile-audited causal overreach explicitly.
solve_count_link: Non-discriminating evidence can close the wrong parent premise or promote a mechanism whose apparent effect is explained by delivery

proposition: Premise-map completeness confidence requires reciprocal source coverage and independent-pass saturation evidence; proposition provenance and internal graph coverage are necessary but cannot establish that premise-bearing source regions were sampled.
status: governing map-completeness premise / admitted after frozen v1 mining
evidence_summary: The hardening reverse-source audit exposed the asymmetry between every proposition having lineage and every premise-bearing source having a disposition. H16 deliberately kept this post-v1 until the first frozen mining round closed.
solve_count_link: A dense internally consistent map can still omit whole premise-bearing source strata and make its negative space look falsely complete.

proposition: Decision-bearing sample size is the opportunity population in which the treatment can causally change the tested outcome, not raw row count or feature eligibility alone.
evidence_summary: Opportunity-sizing authority defines the causal population as intersections such as eligible, control-fails, and treatment-can-execute; Phase-2 independent-unit and economics synthesis again required separating nominal rows from decision-bearing opportunity.
solve_count_link: A large nominal experiment can contain almost no causal headroom
gap_type: turning a null into false negative confidence or a sparse success into misleading prevalence.
source_paths: eligibility; control failure; participation; causal headroom
